proposals.angle: Explains whether a money market fund is an appropriate vehicle for emergency savings, covering liquidity, FDIC vs SIPC distinctions, and the trade-offs versus a high-yield savings account.

proposals.title: Treasury Bills vs CDs for Short-Term Cash
proposals.keyword: treasury bill vs cd short term
proposals.angle: Compares T-bills and certificates of deposit on after-tax yield, liquidity, and FDIC coverage for investors parking cash for three to twelve months.

proposals.title: How the Repo Rate Affects Money Market Yields
proposals.keyword: how repo rate affects money market yields
proposals.angle: Explains the transmission mechanism by which changes in overnight repo rates ripple through to yields on money market funds and short-term instruments.

proposals.title: Taxable vs Tax-Exempt Money Market Funds
proposals.keyword: taxable vs tax-exempt money market fund
proposals.angle: Walks through how to calculate the tax-equivalent yield to decide whether a municipal money market fund beats a prime or government fund for a given tax bracket.

proposals.title: Yield Curve Control: How Central Banks Cap Long-Term Rates
proposals.keyword: how does yield curve control work
proposals.angle: Explains the mechanics by which a central bank fixes a target for a longer-maturity bond yield, why it differs from standard open-market operations, and what risks arise when the peg comes under pressure.

proposals.title: Negative Interest Rates: How Central Banks Use Sub-Zero Policy Rates
proposals.keyword: how do negative interest rates work central bank
proposals.angle: Walks through how a central bank implements a policy rate below zero, the transmission to commercial banks and savers, and the practical limits that constrain how deeply negative rates can go.

proposals.title: Central Bank Currency Swap Lines Explained
proposals.keyword: what are central bank currency swap lines
proposals.angle: Describes how bilateral swap agreements between central banks provide emergency foreign-currency liquidity to domestic financial systems, with examples of when they have been activated.

proposals.title: Exchange Fund Tax Deferral Mechanics
proposals.keyword: how exchange funds defer capital gains tax
proposals.angle: Explains how a high-net-worth investor contributes appreciated stock into an exchange fund to diversify without triggering immediate capital gains, and what tax rules govern the seven-year holding requirement.

proposals.title: REIT Return of Capital: Tax Basis Impact
proposals.keyword: how reit return of capital affects cost basis
proposals.angle: Clarifies how the return-of-capital portion of a REIT distribution reduces a shareholder's cost basis over time and what happens when basis reaches zero.

proposals.title: Structured Note Tax Treatment for Investors
proposals.keyword: how are structured notes taxed
proposals.angle: Walks through how principal-protected and leveraged structured notes are taxed at maturity or sale, including the OID rules that may require annual income recognition before cash is received.

proposals.title: LLC Taxed as Partnership: Investment Gains Pass-Through
proposals.keyword: how investment gains taxed in llc partnership
proposals.angle: Describes how capital gains, qualified dividends, and ordinary income flow through a multi-member LLC to members' personal returns and how the entity's tax character is preserved at the individual level.

proposals.title: Annuity Inside an IRA: The Double-Deferral Myth
proposals.keyword: tax benefit of annuity inside ira
proposals.angle: Addresses the common misconception that placing a tax-deferred annuity inside an already tax-deferred IRA provides extra deferral, explaining what the IRS says and when the combination might still make sense.

proposals.title: Collectibles Fund Tax Rate: The 28% Capital Gains Rule
proposals.keyword: 28 percent capital gains tax collectibles fund
proposals.angle: Explains why gains from funds holding gold coins, art, or other collectibles are taxed at the 28% collectibles rate rather than the standard long-term rate, and how to identify this exposure inside a mutual fund or ETF.

proposals.title: Tenancy in Common: Inherited Property Step-Up in Basis
proposals.keyword: step up in basis tenancy in common inherited property
proposals.angle: Clarifies which portion of a tenancy-in-common property receives a stepped-up basis at a co-owner's death versus which portion retains the surviving owner's original cost basis.

proposals.title: Gross Margin in Cyclical vs Defensive Stocks
proposals.keyword: gross margin cyclical vs defensive stocks
proposals.angle: Explains why gross margin benchmarks differ structurally between cyclical and defensive industries and how to interpret those differences when comparing companies across sectors.

proposals.title: Return on Equity for Capital-Light Businesses
proposals.keyword: return on equity capital light business
proposals.angle: Examines why high ROE in asset-light companies (software, consulting) reads differently than in capital-intensive ones, and when ROE alone can mislead.

proposals.title: EBITDA Margin vs Free Cash Flow Margin
proposals.keyword: ebitda margin vs free cash flow margin
proposals.angle: Compares what each margin measures, why they diverge for capex-heavy or working-capital-intensive businesses, and which is more useful for different analytical purposes.

proposals.title: Negative Net Profit Margin: Common Causes and What It Signals
proposals.keyword: negative net profit margin causes
proposals.angle: Walks through the distinct scenarios that produce a negative net margin — one-time charges, structural losses, startup burn, and leverage costs — and how to distinguish temporary from chronic problems.

proposals.title: DLOM Calculation Methods Compared: Restricted Stock vs Put Option Models
proposals.keyword: how to calculate discount for lack of marketability
proposals.angle: Explains the three main quantitative approaches — restricted-stock studies, pre-IPO studies, and put-option models — and shows how each produces a different DLOM percentage for the same private company.

proposals.title: Revenue Multiple vs EBITDA Multiple for Private Company Valuation
proposals.keyword: revenue multiple vs ebitda multiple private company
proposals.angle: Walks through when a revenue multiple is more appropriate than an EBITDA multiple — such as for pre-profit or high-growth businesses — and how an appraiser chooses between the two.

proposals.title: Holding Company Discount in Private Business Valuation
proposals.keyword: holding company discount valuation
proposals.angle: Explains why a holding company that owns other assets or operating subsidiaries is often valued at a discount to its net asset value, and the factors — portfolio size, liquidity, taxes — that determine the discount magnitude.

proposals.title: Private Company Valuation: Buyout vs Minority Sale
proposals.keyword: private company value difference buyout vs minority stake
proposals.angle: Compares how the same private company is valued differently depending on whether the transaction is a full acquisition or a partial minority-interest sale, covering control premiums, synergy adjustments, and marketability discounts.
